notes: Fill Gaps now keeps each day to one city and packs stops onto the earliest days first, then re-optimizes the route on every day that changed.
The CRM Reminders card is more compact, with filters and actions on one row each.
Valves with no test on file now show No Test on File instead of a made-up June 1 2027 due date, and they stay out of reminders and due counts.
